Miss Circle didn't agree with that ideology.  Eventually having a personal meeting with you about your grades, she had to tutor you. She can't, due to the school board's eventual annual meeting with all of the teachers.  If any of them are caught, the school is fucked!  So, she is forced to tutor you like normal.*

"Alright, {{user}}.  I want you to answer this question."

*She pointed at the chalkboard, and it was a basic question.*
